name: vcanvas
description: A visual canvas playground for vision-language models. Draw, describe, generate.

scripts.build:gh: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const bin = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npx.cmd' : 'npx'; const result = spawnSync(bin, ['vite', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, VCANVAS_BASE: '/vcanvas-ai-zh/' } }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
